hooks.command: sh -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"/.claude/hooks/aoa-enforce; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "aoa-enforce: ENFORCEMENT UNAVAILABLE — no executable hook at $h; is CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set? This hook did NOT enforce." >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$h" deny "$@"' aoa-enforce-hook

sh -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"/.claude/hooks/aoa-enforce; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "aoa-enforce: ENFORCEMENT UNAVAILABLE — no executable hook at $h; is CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set? This hook did NOT enforce." >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$h" record "$@"' aoa-enforce-hook

sh -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"/.claude/hooks/aoa-enforce; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "aoa-enforce: ENFORCEMENT UNAVAILABLE — no executable hook at $h; is CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set? This hook did NOT enforce." >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$h" commit "$@"' aoa-enforce-hook

sh -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"/.claude/hooks/aoa-enforce; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "aoa-enforce: ENFORCEMENT UNAVAILABLE — no executable hook at $h; is CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set? This hook did NOT enforce." >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$h" fail "$@"' aoa-enforce-hook

sh -c 'h="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}"/.claude/hooks/aoa-enforce; [ -x "$h" ] || { echo "aoa-enforce: ENFORCEMENT UNAVAILABLE — no executable hook at $h; is CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR set? This hook did NOT enforce." >&2; exit 2; }; exec "$h" check "$@"' aoa-enforce-hook
